exposure: Consultant obstetrician review of abnormal cardiotocography (CTG) prior to fetal scalp lactate (FSL)
outcome: Number of babies with acidaemia at birth (pH < 7.1)
Number of cesarean sections for presumed fetal distress (CS for FD)
cohort: Women who had a continuous CTG in labor
finding: Consultant obstetrician review of CTG prior to FSL was independently associated with a reduced likelihood of CS for FD.
mod_finding: Consultant obstetrician review of CTG prior to FSL was associated with fewer cesarean sections for presumed fetal distress, fewer instrumental births, and fewer FSL performed.
